feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
entry.summary: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

entry.title: What to make of warnings that AI may pose an existential threat to humanity
entry.summary: Over the past week, fears of AI wiping out humanity are surging. But could it happen? And if so, how?

entry.title: A rare glimpse inside Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon
entry.summary: NPR gains rare access to the Israel-occupied zone of southern Lebanon.

entry.title: A record number of Israelis have been leaving their country over the last 3 years
entry.summary: As many as 50,000 Israelis are leaving the country a year, study shows, tired of war and hardline politicians.

entry.title: Trump administration's crackdown on immigrant truckers rolls into appeals court
entry.summary: A federal appeals court panel in D.C. hears arguments Tuesday on the Trump administration's crackdown on immigrant truckers. Critics say that will do little to make the nation's roads safer.

entry.title: Missed the 2026 Emmys broadcast? Here's a recap
entry.summary: At the Emmys, The Pitt and Widow's Bay took home big wins. There were some beautiful moments, awkward jokes and surprises too.

entry.title: As AI execs worry publicly, Bill Gates would like a word
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Bill Gates, the former Microsoft CEO turned philanthropist, about his contributions to AI equity initiatives -- and his criticisms of an AI-powered future world.

entry.title: For many Pennsylvania Democrats, frustration with Fetterman is at a breaking point
entry.summary: A group of former campaign and Senate staffers for John Fetterman say they will soon begin dropping damaging stories about the Pennsylvania Democrat. Many of his constituents are already fed up.

entry.title: New SpaceX site in Louisiana concerns some residents
entry.summary: Residents in Louisiana near SpaceX's next launch site are concerned about the project's impact on the environment and say they were kept in dark about the deal.

entry.title: CBO says Iran war diving up inflation, puts price tag at $38 billion
entry.summary: Two new, independent reports show detailed looks at the costs of the war in Iran. It's led to shortages in U.S. weapons, supply chain bottlenecks, and a price tag in the tens of billions of dollars.
